description:
Activate Mona Lisa by tapping it, adding at least two mana of any color.
Activate Arcanis's first ability by tapping it, causing you to draw three cards.
Tolarian Kraken triggers three times. Resolve the first two triggers, causing you to pay {2} to untap Arcanis and Mona Lisa.
Resolve the last Tolarian Kraken trigger, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

uses.name: Mona Lisa, Science Geek
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with power 2 or greater
